text:
An inflammatory skin condition involving the skin and/or mucus membranes.
It is a chronic, pruritic and papular condition
Some of the drugs known to cause lichen planus (LP):
- Chloroquine
- Quinacrine
- Quinidine
- Gold
- Streptomycin
- Tetracycline
- NSAIDs
- Phenothiazines
- Hydrochlorothiazide
